ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite and drone imagery processing pipeline for monitoring industrial land and detecting unauthorized environmental degradation in Chhattisgarh.
ideas.problem_statement: Sustainability and industrial compliance monitoring challenges in regional contexts.
ideas.title: EcoIndustrial-Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the exact architectural pattern of regional winners like GeoNex-ATLAS by applying computer vision to satellite data for tangible local industrial compliance.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight automated threat-detection and vulnerability-scoring dashboard tailored for local municipal web infrastructure and small businesses.
ideas.problem_statement: Cybersecurity vulnerabilities in emerging digital infrastructure.
ideas.title: CyberShield Local
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fills a major gap by targeting cybersecurity—one of the explicitly named domains—with an interactive dashboard demonstrating live vulnerability remediation.

ideas.pitch: A localized crop yield and disease risk prediction platform combining historical weather feeds with smartphone leaf-image classification.
ideas.problem_statement: Agricultural resilience and food security in rural India.
ideas.title: AgriPredict AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines high-impact domain utility with a proven winning blueprint of image classification and localized machine learning pipelines.

ideas.pitch: An ML-based energy consumption forecasting and anomaly detection pipeline designed to optimize power grid loads for institutional campuses.
ideas.problem_statement: Energy efficiency and smart grid management challenges.
ideas.title: GridPulse Analytics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts proven time-series forecasting pipelines from energy hackathons to provide immediate, measurable cost-saving utility for campus infrastructure.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision mobile web tool that diagnoses broken public infrastructure from user photos and automatically routes repair priority and instructions to municipal workers.
ideas.problem_statement: Real-world civic maintenance and urban governance bottlenecks.
ideas.title: CivicFix AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs a working computer vision model with a polished live demo that judges can test instantly on their own phones.
